Qualcomm Technologies, Inc. is seeking a Software Development Engineer for its Engineering Group. The role involves designing, developing, integrating, testing, validating, and optimizing low-level device driver software, firmware, and hardware/software interfaces for new MSM ASIC chipsets, while supporting system integration and resolving program deficiencies.
